<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ValidationRule xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Event_Key_Format</fullName>
    <active>true</active>
    <description>Event Key: capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.</description>
    <errorConditionFormula>NOT(REGEX(Event_Key__c, "[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*"))</errorConditionFormula>
    <errorMessage>Event Key: capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.</errorMessage>
</ValidationRule>
